senses.gloss:
दोग्धृ m. [दुह्-तृच्]
1 A cowherd,
a milkman; मेरौ स्थिते दोग्धरि दोहदक्षे
Ku. 1. 2.
--2 A calf.
--3 A
panegyrist, one who writes verses for hire
or reward.
--4 One who performs
anything out of interested motives
(with a view to profit himself).

1 A cow which yields milk.
--2 A wet nurse (having much
milk).
--3 A female who gives
anything (with acc.).
